regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing but not one-narrative regime: AI Infrastructure leads the eligible themes while US Energy Complex is a close challenger (margin 0.185, directional=false). Breadth is narrowing (22/49 eligible, frac 0.45) and rotation absorption is low (0.31), consistent with trend-following discipline rather than an early-handoff signal. Gate is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), so the absolute-trend filter is the one leg with real risk-control value.
emerging_watch: Watching whether US Energy Complex closes the 0.185 margin to AI Infrastructure on a week-over-week basis while breadth holds above 0.6 — a confirmed handoff (Energy taking rank 1 on score) would retire this watch.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The rank-1 leadership is a focus lens, not alpha. The only defensible lean is a de-risked continuation: the theme is eligible (trend-gate passed) and not crowded (z=0.15), so the validated drawdown-avoidance leg supports staying exposed while the trend holds. Durability bar 0.5 with mixed Hurst and thin breadth (0.125) argues for holding only in a trend-confirmed frame.
theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.125) means the 'theme' is concentrated in a few names; mixed Hurst implies the trend is not cleanly persistent, so momentum may already be stale and a shake-out through the narrow base is plausible.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day average while the S&P 500 remains above its own, three weeks out

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the rotation challenger with much healthier breadth (0.636) than the leader and passes the trend gate (eligible=true). It is not crowded (z=0.93). This is a breadth-supported trend continuation, not a momentum-chase: the wider participation is the strongest reason it earns a directional lean rather than just an 'avoid'.
theses.dissent: Energy has a long history of sharp mean-reversion on commodity/OPEC surprises; a headline-driven supply shock can reverse the trend faster than the weekly eligibility gate resets.

falsifier.text: XLE prints a weekly close below its 20-week average while breadth drops under 0.4, before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 3rd and is eligible, but it is flagged crowded (z=1.61). Crowding is a size-down caution only — not a short — so the accountable posture is 'avoid adding' rather than an overweight lean. The trend gate says it can stay, but the crowd texture says don't chase it.
theses.dissent: A clean Hurst 'trend' tag and the highest durability bar (0.75) among leaders means the trend may persist despite crowding; avoiding it loses exposure to a genuinely durable theme.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z falls back under 1.0 while it holds its rank, suggesting the sizing caution has cleared

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
